subpageUsage: Same ProductTabs component as the homepage, configured by props (no explicit `variant` prop). Subpage instances (.wow-customs-homepage) differ in content shape: the intro is plain grey text with no inline links, and is null on two feature routes (an empty 28rem column keeps the heading width); there are always exactly four tabs whose mobile chip text equals the desktop label; the tab copy is one shared paragraph for all four tabs on most pages; the CTA is a constant per page. Layout matches the homepage: H2 left / intro right (stacked <=991), a 37rem tab body with the 60% pane bleeding -10vw right at >=768, and at <=767 a nowrap chip row, the pane (60dvh, 40dvh <=479) then the copy. Used twice on /lms (two instances back to back) and once on each of the 17 /lms/features/* routes (FeatureDetail.jsx, per-route copy from featureDetailData.js).
evidenceNotes: No `variant` prop exists on ProductTabs; the subpage branch is a set of prop overrides. The `variant: "subpage"` const is a contract discriminator only.

Longest real instances: heading 13 words (/lms TABS_B instance), intro 62 words (/lms/features/skills), tab label 11 words (/lms/features/employee-performance-management-software), copy 54 words (/lms/features/mcp).
featureDetailData.js allows a per-tab copy override ([label, copy]) but no route uses it; every tab falls back to d.tabCopy.
On the feature routes the full sentence label is also the <=767 nowrap chip, so the chip row overflows and is clipped by the page's overflow-x-clip wrapper (FeatureDetail.jsx comment).
